name: Kiss Road NA TOUR-LOG
original_name: KISS OF LIFE - [KISS ROAD] 1ST WORLD TOUR In North America TOUR-LOG
overview:
The start of Kiss of Life's first world tour, 'KISS ROAD' In North America

From the preparation process for the tour to the honest appearance behind the stage, and even the small daily lives of the off-days, it is filled with Kiss of Life's unique colors. After returning to Korea after the performance, the members themselves gave a commentary video telling the story of the North American tour
